genius.notes: Reviewed on 2026-10-07. AUDF is an AUD payment token with a conditional contractual right for eligible Forte account holders to redeem 1 AUDF for 1 AUD. The issuer is Forte Securities Australia Pty Limited, confirmed by the AUDF terms, issuer footer and ASIC named-stablecoin instrument; Forte Tech Solutions is the separate account and conversion provider. ASIC AFSL 492490 is Australian licensing context, not GENIUS authorization. No qualifying public U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, issuer-announced GENIUS plan or registered foreign exception was located in the named public sources. Pathway and foreign-exception status remain unknown. The PDS describes monthly independent audits of reserve balances but expressly excludes verification of AUDF tokens in circulation. The August 2026 report, signed on 2026-09-07, audits a reserve bank-account balance only. MonthlyAttestationPresent is omitted rather than treating that assets-only audit as a GENIUS monthly reserve attestation. Reserve and redemption disclosure indicators describe publicly present documents, not compliance with GENIUS reserve requirements. DASP restrictions are prospective under Treasury's opened August proposal. The ABN record corroborates entity identity; its extraction date is 2026-10-08 and it is not used to establish a new authorization on the review date.
